Integrate pump controllers (solenoid valves, water pumps) with MATI Bot via Arduino.

- **Protocol**: Serial ASCII commands

```
P<n>,<speed>  - Set pump n (1-4) speed (0-255)

```

| `/api/pump/all/status` | GET | Get all pump speeds |

# Turn pump 1 on at half speed
